discussion_comments.comment_body:
Thanks for the careful review. This is expected for this repo's AutoRest workflow, so no change is needed in this PR.

The top-level `generated/Datadog/Datadog.Autorest` directory isn't updated by feature PRs. Feature PRs only modify the source under `src/Datadog/` — the AutoRest `README.md` config, custom code, docs/help, examples, and tests. The checked-in `generated/<Module>` mirror is regenerated and committed **separately by the automated "Archive" pipeline after this PR merges** (these land as `[skip ci] Archive …` commits).

Two things confirm this is the established convention:

- `generated/Datadog/` has only ever been touched by `[skip ci] Archive`/infra automation — never by a feature PR.
- The previous Datadog feature PR (#28832) followed the exact same pattern: it modified only `src/Datadog/` and touched zero files under `generated/`. Its new cmdlets appeared under `generated/Datadog/` only afterward, via an Archive commit.

So the `2025-12-26-preview` regeneration under `generated/Datadog/` (including the 5 new cmdlets) will be produced by the Archive automation post-merge. Committing it here would duplicate that automation and add hundreds of generated files this PR isn't meant to own.
